note: The one home of the Home numbers, transcribed from station-layouts.md (Home §5, §6) and its wireframe 01-home.svg. Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin. What the layout document did not give was listed under `derived`; each entry is now the UI designer's decision (2026-10-08), written into the document's Home section too.

derived.colours: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided, see `colours` and Home §4's colour roles. Bezel `metal`, lit `enamel`, shade `bevel` (the derived `bevel`/`hairline` were darker than the metal on both sides); glass edge `frostD`; the placeholder inside is a `forest` back and a `clay` ground band with a `sand` top row and a `soil` foot, the only warm field on screen (the derived `night`/`slate` plate was cold and failed 'the vivarium is the only warm light'); modules the kit's instrument panel with the word in `metal`, engraved and quiet (the derived `bone` out-shone the objects); lamps off `hairline`, well `sprout`, waiting `sky`, needs you `amber`; the ribbon as on Pods; the report card an instrument `panel`, not paper
derived.rack pods: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided: the signed 32×40 well pod, 1:1, at well + (4, 0). It fills the 40×40 well's height, so centred and bottom-aligned are one place: the stem on the well's top row, the shell's foot on its floor. The listed 24×32 is struck. The glint star is centred above its well, well + (14, -12)
derived.message plate: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided: no plate. ← on the room does nothing and the bottom line shows no `← where`; a plate on Home would sit over the living window, which carries no words, and the top bar already names Home. strings.homeTop is gone
derived.waiting lamp: UI designer, 2026-10-08: confirmed: at the resident box's top right, inset 0, so it stays off the creature's body; it rides the resident's 4 px lift; `sky` with a `void` rim
derived.bay lift: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided: 2 px, the chrome lift (frame.json focus.lift.chrome), over 200 ms as the door opens, held while the crates open, settling when the report card shows. At 4 the Bay's top would sit 4 px under the top bar's rule; the door, the beam and the crates carry the arrival. Nothing is scaled
derived.report card: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided (the document gave only its box): `regions.report` and Home §5's table. Heading, one row per crate (pods pictured, the land's reach in words), Gathered (figures beside material icons only), the Probe's mend, the world's lines; 24 px rows, height 104 + 24 × (crates + Probe row) + (lines ? 40 + 24 × lines : 0), at most 312
derived.vocabulary: UI designer, 2026-10-08: decided: a module is a build of panel and the vivarium is a living window, both existing words; the rest knob, the with-you bed and the report card are compositions of panel and sprites, not new words (station-layouts.md, the vocabulary)
